title: Sticky Grant Latch Inferred (Missing Else)
bug_signature: VCS-WARNING: Latch inferred for 'sticky_gnt'; synthesized behavior differs from simulation
rtl:
always_comb
  if (active) sticky_gnt = gnt;  // No else — latch inferred for inactive case
expected_root_cause: The always_comb block assigns sticky_gnt only in the if (active) branch with no else assignment; synthesis infers a latch to hold the previous value of gnt when active=0, causing simulation-synthesis mismatch.
fix_replacement:
always_comb begin
  sticky_gnt = 4'h0;           // Default: no grant
  if (active) sticky_gnt = gnt; // Latch-free: always assigned
end
description: The always_comb block for sticky_gnt has an if without an else, causing synthesis to infer a latch that holds the last value of gnt rather than defaulting to zero when inactive.
failure_log: VCS-WARNING: Latch inferred for 'sticky_gnt'; synthesized behavior differs from simulation
success_log: No latch inferred. sticky_gnt=0 when active=0.
